title: Ammavin Kaipesi

desc: Selvam, a rural folk artist, falls in love with Abhirami, a classical dancer. However, things become complicated when her father disapproves of their relationship.

desc: A fisherman's widow visits the beach every day, hoping that her husband might return, despite being aware of his death and the weird looks from her community.

title: Tholaipesi

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Appu
desc: After falling in love with Suchitra, Appu must go against the odds to win her over and marry her despite her father's disapproval of him.

desc: Two best friends, Siva and Sathya, are very close to each other. However, their lives turn upside down when they choose to marry different people.
